prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop hospitality homepage concept, 1440px-wide landscape canvas, edge to edge with no browser or device frame.
Input images: Image 1 is the exact resort logo and brand reference; Image 2 is the resort's real living-room photograph; Image 3 is a real Elysian apartment bedroom; Image 4 is the real resort court and garden aerial. Treat all supplied photographs as factual, recognizable property imagery. Preserve the actual interiors and architecture.
Primary request: Direction D — Contemporary Boutique Resort for ‘The 12 by Naji Resort’. Build a warm, welcoming, shippable homepage that feels like an independent luxury hotel guest folio, not a generic cream template. Make the living-room photograph a generous off-center editorial window crossing the fold; wrap the headline and short factual copy around it on the same warm ivory ground. Use the exact sentence ‘Discover the privacy of home with the privileges of a resort.’ as the main editorial statement, and ‘The Apartment Resort’ as the concise kicker.
Frame: elegant compact header with the resort mark/name; Rooms, Gallery, Tours, Events, Contact; visible ‘Book Now’. Integrate a quiet stay-planning row into the composition with ‘Check in’, ‘Check out’, ‘Apartment’, and ‘View apartments’. At the start of the next section, introduce ‘Stay your way’ with two unequal room-image columns labelled ‘Elysian’ and ‘Oasis’; avoid card containers.
Visual law: warm ivory #F4EFE6, deep charcoal #24211D, brand gold #B88A3B, walnut #6B4D37, clean linen #FBF8F2. Characterful contemporary serif display paired with a friendly precise sans. Use tactile linen grain very subtly, fine walnut rules, square to barely softened corners, and abundant breathing room. No gradients, no glass, no excessive decoration or shadows.
Constraints: high-legibility real UI, one dominant image, no prices, ratings, awards, fake availability, people, stock imagery, extra logos, or unsupported claims.
